is a ship gone when it's gone and you start from 0?

The short answer is no, but you can read more about what happens after you die/lose your ship here: Death of a Spaceman

If so, what's the point of spending bucks for a ship? Or do you have them in your hangar and you can re-spawn them?

The reason people are spending real-world $ on ships in this game is to help crowd fund the entire game. There is no publisher, there are no investors, the game development is 100% paid for by the early backers of the project. Every ship offered on the online $ store will be purchasable with in-game money when the game comes out so don't feel pressured to spend.

As I mentioned in my post, once the game is released you will not be able to buy ships for $ directly. This is just a mechanism they're currently using to incentivize paying an extra premium to fund the costs of development.

Also, about re-spawning ships see this quick FAQ

If you're comparing purchasing ships in-game to purchasing Heroes in HotS, then the only similarity I'd make is that some ships will cost more and will take longer to acquire while other ships will be relatively cheap and very easy to get, just like heroes in HotS.
